'''Anj Dahl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. As a member of the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], she participated in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]]. After the battle, Dahl was appointed to the position of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jhoram Bey]] was elevated to the rank of second&ndash;in&ndash;command by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]. Dahl was involved in the Galactic Alliance's [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] over [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] and the [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation efforts]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Mon Calamari===
Anj Dahl, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Core Fleet, joined the prestigious [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Caamas]]. As part of that [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], she<ref name="LE CG" /> accompanied fellow Rogue Squadron member and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Monia Gahan]] on a mission in [[137 ABY]]. Monia went to persuade<ref name="Legacy 20" /> her<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> uncle [[Gial Gahan]]&mdash;a former member of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Triumvirate]], and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s friend&mdash;to supply data on the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|advanced]] class of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] under construction at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Dahl acquired supplies, including parts, [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and a bottle of [[Corellian brandy/Legends|Corellian brandy]] for the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] and fellow Rogue Squadron member [[Andurgo]].<ref name="Legacy 20" />

After Monia Gahan successfully convinced her uncle to give the Alliance fleet intel on the ''Imperious'', Dahl and Gahan flew the ''[[Scarlet Star]]'', a modified [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]],<ref name="LE CG" /> back to the [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']] and the fleet to report to Admiral Stazi. They barely missed the fight between Andurgo and [[Hondo Karr]], a former Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. After the [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Jhoram Bey]] broke up the fight between Karr and Andurgo, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] reprimanded Dahl and Gahan for making Admiral Stazi wait.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

Dahl later fought at the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]]. When [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]] had to eject into Dac's atmosphere, Dahl informed Andurgo that she would skin him alive if the Dug's showboating led to Ronto's death.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

===Attack on Ralltiir===
{{Quote|Rogue Leader, this is ''Alliance'' C-and-C. The admiral wants you to rally your squad and fly escort for the ''Steadfast''. They've wandered away from their fleet. Bring them back to it."''<br />"''Jhoram, we're protecting a bunch of Imps while a bunch of other Imps may start taking potshots at us?! This is stupid!"''<br />"''This is an order from the admiral, Anj. Execute.|Jhoram Bey and Dahl|<ref name="Legacy 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>}}
After Bey was promoted by Admiral Stazi to the second-in-command of the Galactic Alliance fleet, Dahl was promoted to Rogue Leader.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

===Mission to Napdu===
{{Quote|At my signal, Rogue Squadron will come in to attack the bounty hunters&mdash;who are following the ''wrong'' transport.''"<br />''"Ho ho ho! And they'll believe ''that'' transport to be the one with the refugees and follow ''it''! ''Egad'', a nice trick! I quite like it!|Dahl and Azzim Anjiliac Atirue|<ref name="Legacy 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref>}}
Sometime after the Battle of Ralltiir, the Galactic Alliance fleet made its way to the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Dahl and the other members of Rogue Squadron were briefed on their next mission by Jhoran Bey. She accompanied Hondo Karr on a [[Mission to Napdu|mission]] to smuggle Mon Calamari refugees from a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Da Soocha]]. While the mission was a success, Karr did not return from it, as he was able to reunite with his wife and return to [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] ways.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I hate this being squad leader stuff. Not what I signed up for. Jhoram was great at it."''<br />"''You're doing all right. Your only problem is seeing your squad mates as friends."''<br />"''And that's a problem ''because''&hellip;?|Anj Dahl and Hondo Karr|<ref name="Legacy 41" />}}
Anj Dahl was known for being eager and talented. She was also known to have been mischievous, starting trouble between her fellow Rogue Squadron members just for her own entertainment. Because she spent most of her years as a young adult in the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet, Dahl felt that everything in her life could be gone anytime. As a result, she embraced anything that seemed fun to her. Dahl excelled at scrounging, and was capable of acquiring ship parts and supplies from most spaceports without alerting the authorities. Her abilities at this were boosted when sympathizers to the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet assisted her.<ref name="LE CG" /> Dahl did not enjoy being Rogue Leader, feeling that her predecessor, Jhoram Bey, was better at leading the Rogue Squadron than her. She viewed her fellow squad members, including Hondo Karr, as her friends, and was loyal to them. Dahl was not willing to lose any of the Rogue Squadron members on her watch, and did not wish to leave a man behind.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

Dahl spoke and comprehended [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. She was also capable of understanding [[Binary/Legends|Binary]]. Dahl was skilled in unarmed combat. She possessed a padded [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]], a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol, a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="LE CG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anj Dahl was created by [[John Ostrander]], the writer of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars: Legacy|''Legacy'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, for the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Indomitable|''Indomitable'']] story arc. She later appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 36|thirty-sixth]] and [[Legacy (2006) 41|forty-second]] issues of the ''Legacy'' series. Dahl also appeared in the [[Legacy — War 2|second]], [[Legacy — War 3|third]], and [[Legacy — War 5|fifth]] issues of ''Star Wars: Legacy''{{'s}} followup miniseries, [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']]. Dahl received an entry in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and released on [[March 17]], [[2009]]. Dahl was drawn by [[Omar Francia]] for the ''Indomitable'' and ''Renegade'' storylines. In the story ''Rogue's End'', she was penciled by [[Kajo Baldisimo]]; Dahl was drawn by [[Jan Duursema]] in ''The Fate of Dac'' and in her three appearances in ''Star Wars: Legacy—War''.
